profile_text.body:
Synopsys is a public company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, traded under the ticker SNPS, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000883241. On its own site the company describes itself as a provider of silicon-to-systems solutions spanning EDA tools, semiconductor IP, and systems verification, and says these help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk, and drive breakthroughs. Its site also carries a notice that visitors may interact with an AI-powered chatbot that gives general information about Synopsys products and services, that the information may be incorrect or incomplete, that applicable agreements supersede anything the chatbot says, and that chats may be accessed by Synopsys and its service providers to customize the experience and improve the tool.

The site highlights work with Samsung Foundry processes, describing advances in power and performance for AI and multi-die designs presented at SAFE Forum 2026.

Litigation records associated with the company list 264 cases in California. No product listings or MCP servers are recorded for it.
